content.comment_body: To improve user experience, I suggest implementing a right-click menu that allows activation of an analog device or similar functions, with the corresponding line highlighted in green. If cascading events occur, related lines should appear in red and blink. This feature would be particularly helpful when working with large programs.

analysis.insight_summary: The user finds it difficult to navigate and understand large projects in [product_name] software. They suggest enhancing visualization by enabling right-click actions to activate devices and display signal paths in various colors, which would increase clarity and assist in monitoring or troubleshooting cascading events within the logic diagram—especially for complex applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects intuitive color-coded visual feedback and interactive options, such as a right-click menu, to activate and track analog devices and events easily in the software.
